news.titleSw: Nafasi za Kidato cha Kwanza (2026) na Uhamisho Ziko Wazi Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni
news.titleEn: Form 1 (2026) Admissions and Student Transfers Now Open at Uomboni Secondary School
news.excerptSw: Uongozi wa Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni unawakaribisha wazazi na walezi kuomba nafasi za masomo ya bweni na kutwa kwa wavulana na wasichana kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026.
news.excerptEn: Uomboni Secondary School administration invites parents and guardians to apply for boarding and day school admissions for boys and girls for the 2026 academic year.
news.contentSw: Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni (Kituo cha NECTA S0486) iliyopo Marangu Magharibi, Moshi Vijijini chini ya Jimbo Katoliki Moshi inatangaza nafasi za kujiunga na Kidato cha Kwanza kwa mwaka 2026. Pia nafasi za uhamisho kwa Kidato cha Pili na Tatu zipo wazi. Fomu za kujiunga (Joining Instructions) zinapatikana mtandaoni kwenye tovuti hii au katika ofisi kuu ya Mkuu wa Shule Marangu.
news.contentEn: Uomboni Secondary School (NECTA Center S0486), located in Marangu West, Moshi Rural under the Catholic Diocese of Moshi, announces admission openings for Form One for the 2026 academic year. Transfer opportunities for Form Two and Three are also available. Official Joining Instructions can be downloaded online via this portal or obtained from the Headmaster’s office.
news.author: Ofisi ya Mkuu wa Shule

news.titleSw: Ufaulu wa Juu Mitihani ya Taifa NECTA na Kambi Maalum ya Kitaaluma Kidato cha Nne
news.titleEn: High NECTA National Exam Performance & Special Academic Revision Camp for Form 4
news.excerptSw: Kituo cha NECTA S0486 Uomboni kimeendeleza rekodi thabiti ya ufaulu wa Daraja la I, II na III huku kambi ya kitaaluma ya maandalizi ya mitihani ya mwisho ikianza rasmi.
news.excerptEn: NECTA Center S0486 Uomboni sustains its remarkable pass rate in Division I, II, and III as the intensive academic preparation camp commences.
news.contentSw: Uongozi wa kitaaluma unawapongeza walimu na wanafunzi kwa matokeo mazuri ya mitihani ya Taifa ya Kidato cha Nne (NECTA CSEE) ambapo watahiniwa wote walifaulu kwa viwango vya juu (Division I: 3, Division II: 8, Division III: 14, Division IV: 3, Division 0: 0). Shule imeandaa mikakati thabiti ya mitihani ya majaribio (Mock Tests) na usimamizi wa karibu wa masomo ya jioni (Evening Supervised Prep).
news.contentEn: The academic administration congratulates our dedicated teachers and students for stellar performance in the Form Four National Examination (NECTA CSEE) with candidates passing in high divisions (Division I: 3, Division II: 8, Division III: 14, Division IV: 3, Division 0: 0). The school has instituted mock assessments and supervised evening study routines.
news.author: Makamu Mkuu wa Shule (Taaluma)

news.titleSw: Ufunguzi wa Maabara ya Kisasa ya TEHAMA na Kompyuta kwa Wanafunzi Wote
news.titleEn: Commissioning of Modern ICT & Computer Laboratory for Practical Digital Skills
news.excerptSw: Wanafunzi wote kuanzia Kidato cha 1 hadi 4 sasa wanaanza kupata mafunzo ya vitendo ya kompyuta, TEHAMA na matumizi ya mifumo ya kidijitali katika kujifunzia.
news.excerptEn: All students from Form 1 through Form 4 now receive practical computer literacy, ICT skills, and modern technology-assisted learning.
news.contentSw: Katika kuwajengea wanafunzi ujuzi na umahiri unaoendana na karne ya 21, Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni imekamilisha ukarabati na ufungaji wa kompyuta mpya zenye programu za kielimu na mtandao wa kasi. Hii itawawezesha wanafunzi kufanya utafiti wa kitaaluma na kujiandaa vyema kwa masomo ya sayansi na teknolojia.
news.contentEn: To empower students with essential 21st-century digital competencies, Uomboni Secondary School has commissioned a fully equipped ICT suite with modern workstations and high-speed internet, enhancing academic research and STEM education.
news.author: Idara ya Sayansi na TEHAMA

news.titleSw: Misa Takatifu ya Shukrani na Malezi ya Kiroho na Maadili (Jimbo Katoliki Moshi)
news.titleEn: Eucharistic Thanksgiving Mass & Moral Formation for Boarding and Day Students
news.excerptSw: Mlezi wa kiroho na jumuia ya shule wameadhimisha ibada ya shukrani kuombea amani, nidhamu, afya na ufaulu wa kitaaluma kwa muhula huu wa masomo.
news.excerptEn: School chaplain and campus community celebrated a solemn Mass of thanksgiving, praying for peace, discipline, good health, and academic excellence.
news.contentSw: Kama shule inayoongozwa na kaulimbiu ya "SALA, ELIMU NA KAZI", ibada za mara kwa mara na malezi ya maadili mema huwasaidia wanafunzi kukua wakiwa na hofu ya Mungu, upendo, heshima kwa jamii na nidhamu thabiti ya kibinafsi.
news.contentEn: Guided by the school motto "PRAYER, EDUCATION AND WORK", regular liturgical celebrations and pastoral care nurture disciplined, God-fearing, empathetic, and responsible young leaders.
news.author: Idara ya Malezi ya Kiroho (Chaplaincy)

news.titleSw: Ushindi wa Timu za Shule kwenye Michezo ya UMISETA na Bonanza la Riadha
news.titleEn: Uomboni Sports Teams Triumph in Inter-School UMISETA Athletics & Football
news.excerptSw: Timu ya mpira wa miguu, mpira wa pete na riadha ya Uomboni imeibuka kidedea katika mashindano ya shule za sekondari ukanda wa Marangu.
news.excerptEn: Uomboni football, netball, and athletics teams registered outstanding victories in regional inter-school competitions across the Marangu educational circuit.
news.contentSw: Michezo hujenga afya, ujasiri na mshikamano. Wanafunzi walishiriki michezo mbalimbali ikiwemo riadha, mpira wa wavu na sanaa za maonyesho huku wakionyesha vipaji vikubwa na nidhamu ya hali ya juu.
news.contentEn: Sports foster physical fitness, resilience, and teamwork. Students showcased great athletic talent across track, volleyball, and performing arts with high discipline.
news.author: Idara ya Michezo na Utamaduni

news.titleSw: Mkutano Mkuu wa Wazazi na Walimu (PTA) Kujadili Maendeleo na Miradi ya Shule
news.titleEn: Annual Parents-Teachers Association (PTA) Meeting on Academic & Hostel Upgrades
news.excerptSw: Bodi ya Shule na uongozi wamewashukuru wazazi kwa ushirikiano mkubwa katika kuboresha miundombinu ya shule na lishe ya wanafunzi wa bweni.
news.excerptEn: The School Board and leadership commended parents for outstanding partnership in infrastructure enhancements and boarding student welfare.
news.contentSw: Mkutano ulijadili mipango ya upanuzi wa hosteli za wanafunzi, uboreshaji wa maktaba ya shule na mikakati madhubuti ya kuendeleza ufaulu wa alama za juu katika mitihani ya NECTA kwa ushirikiano wa karibu na walimu.
news.contentEn: The meeting reviewed student boarding dormitory upgrades, library reference stock expansion, and collaborative strategies between parents and faculty to sustain high academic standards.
news.author: Bodi ya Shule & Kamati ya Wazazi

events.descriptionEn: Eucharistic celebration seeking God’s guidance and divine blessings for the new academic term and candidate class national exams.

joiningDocs.titleSw: Tangazo Rasmi la Udahili 2026/2027 (Pre-Form One, Kidato cha 1 & 3)
joiningDocs.descriptionSw: Tangazo rasmi linaloainisha tarehe ya kuanza Pre-Form One (21/09/2026), fomu za kujiunga na mawasiliano ya ofisi Marangu, Moshi na Ngarenaro.
joiningDocs.descriptionEn: Official admissions flyer detailing Pre-Form One opening date (21/09/2026), registration forms and contact channels in Marangu, Moshi and Ngarenaro.

pdfContentPreview.header:
SHULE YA SEKONDARI UOMBONI - TANGAZO RASMI LA UDAHILI 2026/2027
S.L.P 361 MARANGU, MOSHI (NECTA S0486)
requirements: Nafasi za Kidato cha 1 na Kidato cha 3 (2026/2027) ziko wazi kwa wavulana na wasichana (Bweni & Kutwa).
Fomu za kujiunga zinapatikana: Shuleni Marangu, Moshi Bookshop, na Ngarenaro.
pdfContentPreview.feesSummary: Ada nafuu sana inayolipwa kwa awamu ili kumwezesha mzazi.

joiningDocs.titleSw: Fomu Rasmi ya Maelekezo ya Kujiunga Kidato cha Kwanza (Form One Joining Instructions 2026)
joiningDocs.titleEn: Official Form One 2026 Joining Instructions & Admission Pack
joiningDocs.descriptionSw: Muongozo kamili unaoainisha ada ya shule, mahitaji ya bweni, orodha ya vifaa, muundo wa sare za shule na tarehe rasmi ya kuripoti kwa wateule wote wa kidato cha kwanza.
joiningDocs.descriptionEn: Comprehensive admission package detailing fees breakdown, boarding checklist, school uniform guidelines and reporting schedule for incoming Form One students.

pdfContentPreview.header:
SHULE YA SEKONDARI UOMBONI
S.L.P 361 MARANGU - MOSHI VIJIJINI, KILIMANJARO (NECTA S0486)
FOMU YA MAELEKEZO YA KUJIUNGA NA KIDATO CHA KWANZA (2026)
requirements: Sare za shule: Suruali/Sketi za rangi ya kijivu, mashati ya mikono mifupi ya bluu bahari, tai ya shule, sweta ya bluu yenye nembo.
Vifaa vya Taaluma: Mathematical Set ya Oxford, Kamusi ya Kiswahili & Oxford English Dictionary, Daftari kubwa (Counter Books) 12, Kalamu na Rula.
Mahitaji ya Bweni: Godoro la 2.5ft x 6ft, Shuka 2 za bluu bahari, Chandalua cha duara, Ndoo 2 za maji, Sanduku la chuma lenye kufuli.
Fomu ya Uchunguzi wa Afya (Medical Form) iliyojazwa na kugongwa muhuri na daktari wa Hospitali ya Serikali au Teule (DDH).
pdfContentPreview.feesSummary: Ada ya Bweni kwa Mwaka: TZS 1,300,000/= (Inalipwa kwa awamu 2 au 4). Ada ya Kutwa: TZS 600,000/= kwa mwaka.
pdfContentPreview.reportingDate: Jumapili, Tarehe 11 Januari 2026 (Kuanzia saa 2:00 Asubuhi hadi 11:00 Jioni).

joiningDocs.titleSw: Fomu ya Maombi ya Uhamisho wa Kidato cha Pili na Tatu (Form 2 & 3 Transfer Form)
joiningDocs.titleEn: Form Two & Form Three Student Transfer Application Form
joiningDocs.descriptionSw: Fomu ya wazazi wanaoomba watoto wao kuhamia Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni kutoka shule nyingine za serikali au binafsi.
joiningDocs.descriptionEn: Official application dossier for students wishing to transfer into Form 2 or Form 3 from other schools.

pdfContentPreview.header:
MAOMBI YA UHAMISHO WA KITAALUMA - UOMBONI SECONDARY SCHOOL (NECTA S0486)
IDARA YA USAILI NA USAJILI
requirements: Ripoti ya mwisho ya matokeo ya shule anayotoka mwanafunzi yenye muhuri rasmi.
Barua ya uthibitisho wa tabia njema kutoka kwa Mkuu wa Shule anayotoka.
Kufanya mtihani wa usaili wa shule ya Uomboni katika masomo ya msingi.

joiningDocs.titleSw: Fomu ya Uchunguzi wa Afya ya Mwanafunzi (Medical Examination Form)
joiningDocs.descriptionSw: Fomu maalum inayotakiwa kujazwa na daktari aliyesajiliwa kabla mwanafunzi hajaripoti shuleni ili kuhakikisha huduma sahihi ya afya.
joiningDocs.descriptionEn: Mandatory medical fitness and history questionnaire to be signed by a registered medical practitioner.

pdfContentPreview.header:
SHULE YA SEKONDARI UOMBONI - TAARIFA YA AFYA YA MWANAFUNZI
(Ijazwe na Daktari wa Hospitali)
requirements: Vipimo vya damu (Blood Group, Sickle Cell, Full Blood Picture).
Vipimo vya macho, masikio na mfumo wa upumuaji.
Historia ya magonjwa ya muda mrefu au mzio.
pdfContentPreview.feesSummary: Fomu hii lazima iwasilishwe siku ya kuripoti shuleni.

joiningDocs.titleSw: Kanuni, Sheria na Taratibu za Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni (School Rules & Code of Conduct)
joiningDocs.titleEn: School Rules, Moral Guidelines & Code of Conduct
joiningDocs.descriptionSw: Mwongozo wa nidhamu, maadili, kanuni za maabara, maktaba na maisha ya bweni kwa wanafunzi wote.
joiningDocs.descriptionEn: Code of conduct detailing academic discipline, dormitory guidelines and moral behavior.

pdfContentPreview.header:
KANUNI NA MAADILI YA NIDHAMU - UOMBONI SECONDARY SCHOOL
ELIMU NI MWANGA NA MAADILI MEMA
requirements: Kuhudhuria vipindi vyote vya masomo na ibada kwa wakati.
Ni marufuku kabisa kumiliki simu ya mkononi au kifaa cha kielektroniki kisichoidhinishwa shuleni.
Kutunza usafi wa mazingira ya shule na mali zote za shule.
pdfContentPreview.feesSummary: Uzingatiaji wa maadili ni nguzo kuu ya Uomboni.
pdfContentPreview.reportingDate: Kusomwa na kutiwa saini na mzazi na mwanafunzi kabla ya usajili.

schoolProfile.name: UOMBONI SECONDARY SCHOOL
schoolProfile.location: Marangu, Moshi Vijijini, Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
schoolProfile.vision: To provide quality education and impressive academic performance
schoolProfile.visionSw: Kutoa elimu bora na ufaulu wa kuvutia kitaaluma
schoolProfile.mission: To educate boys and girls to their full potential so that they become independent and disciplined persons who can face contemporary and future challenges through the cooperation with parents and relevant community.
schoolProfile.missionSw: Kuelimisha wavulana na wasichana kufikia uwezo wao kamili ili wawe watu wanaojitegemea na wenye nidhamu wanaoweza kukabiliana na changamoto za sasa na zijazo kupitia ushirikiano na wazazi na jamii husika.
schoolProfile.historySummarySw: Shule ya Sekondari Uomboni ilianzishwa rasmi mwaka 1985 na kufanya mitihani yake ya kwanza ya Taifa ya NECTA (CSEE) mwaka 1988, ikijenga historia ya zaidi ya miaka 40 ya uongozi bora wa kitaaluma na maadili mema.
schoolProfile.historySummaryEn: Uomboni Secondary School was founded in 1985 and its pioneer class sat for NECTA CSEE national examinations in 1988, establishing over 40 years of academic distinction and moral leadership.

coreValues.title: PRAYER
coreValues.description: To enhance students to rely on prayer through different religious practices.
coreValues.descriptionSw: Kukuza wanafunzi kumtegemea Mungu kupitia maombi na taratibu mbalimbali za kiimani.

coreValues.title: DISCIPLINE
coreValues.description: To assist students adhere to standard social and moral behaviour.
coreValues.descriptionSw: Kuwasaidia wanafunzi kuzingatia misingi imara ya maadili mema na nidhamu ya kijamii.

coreValues.title: HARD WORKING
coreValues.description: To empower students to focus on hard working so as to achieve expected academic goals.
coreValues.descriptionSw: Kuwawezesha wanafunzi kujituma na kufanya kazi kwa bidii ili kufikia malengo ya kitaaluma.

coreValues.title: CO-OPERATION
coreValues.description: To build mutual understanding and interaction among students, parents, teachers, and non-teaching staff.
coreValues.descriptionSw: Kujenga maelewano na mshikamano thabiti baina ya wanafunzi, wazazi, walimu na wafanyakazi wasio walimu.
